reviews.title: So many ads!!!
reviews.text: I do NOT like this app at ALL every time I try to make a sound another ad pops up and after I’m done with the ads they ask my to pay for smth I don’t wanna pay for then I play the sound and it’s not as it is in the ad and you barely get any options fix this terrible app pls

reviews.title: I think this app is overrated
reviews.text: The app cost about $10 just to play with some noise noises. You can get them off of YouTube anyway anyways or other things that don’t cost $10. My children love these funny sounds so I let them get another app. That is way better.
